import RNA

n=len(target)
# helix list: (left_start, left_end, right_start, right_end) inclusive, 5'->3'
# pairs: left i pairs with right (rev)
helices=[
    (5,12,271,278),   # 8bp outer
    (16,25,88,97),    # 10bp
    (28,31,42,45),    # 4bp hp1a
    (48,51,62,65),    # 4bp hp1b
    (68,71,82,85),    # 4bp hp1c
    (101,110,173,182),# 10bp
    (113,116,127,130),
    (133,136,147,150),
    (153,156,167,170),
    (186,195,258,267),
    (198,201,212,215),
    (218,221,232,235),
    (238,241,252,255),
]
# distinct stem sequences (5' half), right half = complement reversed
stems8=['GGGAGUGC']  # 8
stems10=['GGGAGUGCCC','GAGUGCGAGG','GCGAGUGAGC']  # 3 distinct 10-mers, each self-avoid crossing
stems4=['GUGC','GCUG','UGCG','CUGG','AGGC','GACG','CGUG','UCGA','GAGC']  # 9 distinct 4-mers

seq=['A']*n
def comp(c):
    return {'A':'U','U':'A','G':'C','C':'G'}[c]
def revcomp(s):
    return ''.join(comp(c) for c in reversed(s))

# assign outer 8
s=stems8[0]
for k in range(8):
    seq[5+k]=s[k]
    seq[278-k]=comp(s[k])  # right side 5'->3' is revcomp; position 278 pairs with 5
# check: pair (5,278),(6,277)... so seq[5] pairs seq[278], seq[6] pairs seq[277]
# so right side seq[271..278] should be revcomp(s)? seq[271]=comp(seq[12])... 
# Actually pair (12,271): seq[12] pairs seq[271]. seq[12]=s[7]. so seq[271]=comp(s[7]).
# pair (5,278): seq[5]=s[0], seq[278]=comp(s[0]).
# So right sequence positions 271..278 = comp(s[7]),comp(s[6])...comp(s[0]) = revcomp(s). good.

def assign_helix(left_a,left_b,right_a,right_b,stem):
    # left positions left_a..left_b get stem 5'->3'; right positions right_a..right_b get revcomp
    L=left_b-left_a+1
    for k in range(L):
        seq[left_a+k]=stem[k]
    rc=revcomp(stem)
    for k in range(L):
        seq[right_a+k]=rc[k]

assign_helix(16,25,88,97,'GGGAGUGCCC')
assign_helix(101,110,173,182,'GAGUGCGAGG')
assign_helix(186,195,258,267,'GCGAGUGAGC')
# 4bp hairpins

hi4=[(28,31,42,45),(48,51,62,65),(68,71,82,85),(113,116,127,130),(133,136,147,150),(153,156,167,170),(198,201,212,215),(218,221,232,235),(238,241,252,255)]
for h,s in zip(hi4,s4):
    assign_helix(*h,s)

# loops already 'A'
full=''.join(seq)

print(len(full))
# fold

print(ss)
